$comment: Canonical overlay theme tokens. Single source of truth for OverlayPalette (iOS) and hud/Theme OverlayEmerald/OverlayAmber (Android). Resolved drifts are recorded in _resolved so neither side 'fixes' them back. Dash lengths are specified in iOS points; Android px values are exactly 2x (density rule), NOT drift.
_resolved: emerald: iOS float (0.20,0.84,0.29) converts to #33D64A; Android #32D74B differs by 1 LSB in R/G — align Android to #33D64A.
emerald_deep: iOS (0.13,0.75,0.42) converts to #21BF6B; Android gradient #22C55E (34,197,94) visibly drifts in G/B — align Android to #21BF6B.
amber: exact match both sides (#FFCC00), no action.

pulse.note: iOS implements repeat pulse; Android currently fades only — adopt pulse.
